
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/22488819" title="发布于 2026-08-15 09:51">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#.NET源生成器如何处理XML注释文档</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        XML注释文档是.net代码很重要部分。Roslyn提供了处理 XML注释文档的 API。提供了按文档生成代码及生成含文档的代码便利性。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="1-前言">1. 前言</h2>
<h3 id="11-roslyn支持xml注释文档">1.1 Roslyn支持XML注释文档</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Roslyn支持从ISymbol获取XML注释文档</li>
<li>Roslyn支持从SyntaxTree节点获取XML注释文档</li>
<li>Roslyn支持对SyntaxTree节点添加XML注释文档</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="12-源生成器需要生成xml注释文档">1.2 源生成器需要生成XML注释文档</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>XML注释文档是源代码很重要的一部分</li>
<li>可用于代码提示</li>
<li>用于提高代码可读性</li>
<li>用于生成API文档</li>
<li>如果源生成器不支持XML注释文档,大多只能停留在demo层面用于装十三</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="2-注释">2. 注释</h2>
<h3 id="21-单行注释">2.1 单行注释</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxTrivia comment = SyntaxFactory.Comment("// singleLine Comment");
Assert.True(comment.IsKind(SyntaxKind.SingleLineCommentTrivia));
</code></pre>
<h2 id="22-多行注释">2.2 多行注释</h2>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxTrivia comment = SyntaxFactory.Comment("/* MultiLine\r\n Comment */");
Assert.True(comment.IsKind(SyntaxKind.MultiLineCommentTrivia));
</code></pre>
<h2 id="3-xmlelementsyntax">3. XmlElementSyntax</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>XmlElementSyntax是构成 XML文档注释的核心部分之一</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="31-xmlelementsyntax定义">3.1 XmlElementSyntax定义</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>由开始标签(StartTag)、子元素(Content)和结束标签(EndTag)组成</li>
<li>是个标准的XML结构</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class XmlElementSyntax : XmlNodeSyntax
{
    XmlElementStartTagSyntax StartTag { get; }
    SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; Content { get; }
    XmlElementEndTagSyntax EndTag { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="32-xmlelementsyntax简单的case">3.2 XmlElementSyntax简单的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过 SyntaxFactory.XmlElement方法构造 XmlElementSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; content = [SyntaxFactory.XmlText("用户名")];
XmlElementSyntax summary = SyntaxFactory.XmlElement("summary", content);
Assert.Equal("&lt;summary&gt;", summary.StartTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;/summary&gt;", summary.EndTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;summary&gt;用户名&lt;/summary&gt;", summary.ToFullString());
</code></pre>
<h2 id="4-xmlnameattributesyntax">4. XmlNameAttributeSyntax</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>XmlNameAttributeSyntax是表示 XML文档中的属性主要的类之一</li>
<li>XmlAttributeSyntax是属性的抽象基类</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="41-xmlnameattributesyntax定义">4.1 XmlNameAttributeSyntax定义</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>由属性名(Name)、等号(EqualsToken)、引号(StartQuoteToken和EndQuoteToken)和属性值(Identifier)组成</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class XmlNameAttributeSyntax : XmlAttributeSyntax
{
    XmlNameSyntax Name { get; }
    SyntaxToken EqualsToken { get; }
    SyntaxToken StartQuoteToken { get; }
    IdentifierNameSyntax Identifier { get; }
    SyntaxToken EndQuoteToken { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="42-xmlnameattributesyntax的case">4.2 XmlNameAttributeSyntax的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.XmlNameAttribute方法构造XmlNameAttributeSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">XmlNameAttributeSyntax attribute = SyntaxFactory.XmlNameAttribute("id");
Assert.Equal(" name=\"id\"", attribute.ToFullString());
</code></pre>
<h3 id="43-xmlnameattributesyntax结合xmlelementsyntax的case">4.3 XmlNameAttributeSyntax结合XmlElementSyntax的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>XmlNameAttributeSyntax一般都是结合XmlElementSyntax来使用的</li>
<li>XmlElementSyntax通过StartTag的AddAttributes方法添加属性</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; content = [SyntaxFactory.XmlText("用户")];
XmlElementSyntax element = SyntaxFactory.XmlElement("param", content);
XmlNameAttributeSyntax attribute = SyntaxFactory.XmlNameAttribute("userId");
element = element.WithStartTag(element.StartTag.AddAttributes(attribute));
Assert.Equal("&lt;param name=\"userId\"&gt;", element.StartTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;/param&gt;", element.EndTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;param name=\"userId\"&gt;用户&lt;/param&gt;", element.ToFullString());
</code></pre>
<h2 id="5-xml注释文档">5. XML注释文档</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>XML注释文档是单行注释</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="51-documentationcommenttriviasyntax">5.1 DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax是用于表示XML注释文档的类</li>
<li>DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax主要是包含子元素(Content)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax : StructuredTriviaSyntax
{
    SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; Content { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="52-summary注释简单的case">5.2 Summary注释简单的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>调用SyntaxFactory.XmlSummaryElement方法生成XmlElementSyntax</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.XmlSummaryElement方法是对上面SyntaxFactory.XmlElement方法的封装</li>
<li>调用SyntaxGenerator.CreateDocumentation生成</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; context = [SyntaxFactory.XmlText("用户名")];
XmlElementSyntax summary = SyntaxFactory.XmlSummaryElement(context);
Assert.Equal("&lt;summary&gt;", summary.StartTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;/summary&gt;", summary.EndTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;summary&gt;用户名&lt;/summary&gt;", summary.ToFullString());
DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax documentation = SyntaxGenerator.CreateDocumentation(summary);
Assert.True(documentation.IsKind(SyntaxKind.SingleLineDocumentationCommentTrivia));
Assert.Equal("/// &lt;summary&gt;用户名&lt;/summary&gt;\r\n", documentation.ToFullString());
</code></pre>
<h3 id="53-大部分xml注释文档有换行">5.3 大部分XML注释文档有换行</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>换行XML注释文档如下</li>
<li>这样的XML注释文档也是可以实现的</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-text">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 用户名
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="54-summary换行注释的case">5.4 Summary换行注释的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>context对比4.2前后多了XmlNewLine(true)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; context = [XmlNewLine(true), SyntaxFactory.XmlText("用户名"), XmlNewLine(true)];
XmlElementSyntax summary = SyntaxFactory.XmlSummaryElement(context);
Assert.Equal("&lt;summary&gt;", summary.StartTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;/summary&gt;", summary.EndTag.ToFullString());
Assert.Equal("&lt;summary&gt;\r\n/// 用户名\r\n/// &lt;/summary&gt;", summary.ToFullString());
DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax documentation = SyntaxGenerator.CreateDocumentation(summary);
Assert.True(documentation.IsKind(SyntaxKind.SingleLineDocumentationCommentTrivia));
Assert.Equal("/// &lt;summary&gt;\r\n/// 用户名\r\n/// &lt;/summary&gt;\r\n", documentation.ToFullString());

static XmlTextSyntax XmlNewLine(bool continueComment)
    =&gt; SyntaxFactory.XmlText(SyntaxFactory.XmlTextNewLine("\r\n", continueComment));
</code></pre>
<h2 id="6-复杂xml注释文档">6. 复杂XML注释文档</h2>
<h3 id="61-含复杂xml注释文档的代码的case">6.1 含复杂XML注释文档的代码的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>EntityKey类的XML注释文档含summary、typeparam和param</li>
<li>其中typeparam和param还都含name属性</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 实体主键
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TKey"&gt;主键类型&lt;/typeparam&gt;
/// &lt;param name="key"&gt;主键&lt;/param&gt;
public class EntityKey&lt;TKey&gt;(TKey key)
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 主键
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public TKey Key { get; } = key;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="62-使用roslyn生成entitykey类的xml注释文档">6.2 使用Roslyn生成EntityKey类的XML注释文档</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>构造summary、typeparam和paramd等3个XmlElementSyntax</li>
<li>使用换行符line分割3个XmlElementSyntax及XmlNewLine(false)作为documentation的子元素</li>
<li>调用SyntaxFactory.DocumentationComment构造XML注释文档</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var line = XmlNewLine(true);
XmlElementSyntax summary = XmlSummary("实体主键", separator);
XmlElementSyntax typeparam = NamedXmlElement("typeparam", "TKey", "主键类型");
XmlElementSyntax param = NamedXmlElement("param", "key", "主键");
XmlNodeSyntax[] content = [summary, separator, typeparam, separator, param, XmlNewLine(false)];
DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax documentation = SyntaxFactory.DocumentationComment(content);
var code = documentation.ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("&lt;summary&gt;", code);


static XmlElementSyntax NamedXmlElement(string elementName, string name, string text)
{
    SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; content = [SyntaxFactory.XmlText(text)];
    XmlElementSyntax element = SyntaxFactory.XmlElement(elementName, content);
    XmlNameAttributeSyntax attribute = SyntaxFactory.XmlNameAttribute(name);
    return element.WithStartTag(element.StartTag.AddAttributes(attribute));
}
static XmlElementSyntax XmlSummary(string summary, XmlTextSyntax line)
{
    SyntaxList&lt;XmlNodeSyntax&gt; summaryContext = [line, SyntaxFactory.XmlText(summary), line];
    return SyntaxFactory.XmlSummaryElement(summaryContext);
}
static XmlTextSyntax XmlNewLine(bool continueComment)
    =&gt; SyntaxFactory.XmlText(SyntaxFactory.XmlTextNewLine("\r\n", continueComment));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="63-以上代码生成的xml注释文档">6.3 以上代码生成的XML注释文档</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>生成的XML注释文档与源代码中的还原度为100%</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-text">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 实体主键
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TKey"&gt;主键类型&lt;/typeparam&gt;
/// &lt;param name="key"&gt;主键&lt;/param&gt;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="64-生成复杂xml注释文档更通用的方法">6.4 生成复杂XML注释文档更通用的方法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>先构造Comment对象</li>
<li>Comment支持Summary、多个TypeParams、多个Params及Returns</li>
<li>调用SyntaxGenerator.CreateDocumentation生成XML注释文档</li>
<li>该示例生成结果与5.2完全一致</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var comment = new Comment() 
{
    Summary = "实体主键",
    TypeParams = { { "TKey", "主键类型" } },
    Params = { { "key", "主键" } }
};
DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax? documentation = SyntaxGenerator.CreateDocumentation(comment);
Assert.NotNull(documentation);
var code = documentation.ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("&lt;summary&gt;", code);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="7-单行注释生成xml注释文档">7. 单行注释生成XML注释文档</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>单行注释生成XML注释文档是可行的</li>
<li>但是不推荐</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="71-单行注释生成xml注释文档的case">7.1 单行注释生成XML注释文档的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.Comment生成单行注释</li>
<li>这种方式生成复杂文档大概率、需要大量字符串拼接</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxTrivia comment = SyntaxFactory.Comment("/// &lt;summary&gt;This is  comment&lt;/summary&gt;");
var method = SyntaxGenerator.VoidType.Method("Test")
    .WithBody(SyntaxFactory.Block())
    .WithLeadingTrivia(comment);
var code = method.ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("&lt;summary&gt;", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="72-生成的代码如下">7.2 生成的代码如下</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;This is  comment&lt;/summary&gt;
void Test()
{
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="8-从isymbol解析xml注释文档">8. 从ISymbol解析XML注释文档</h2>
<h3 id="81-读取xml注释文档">8.1 读取XML注释文档</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过方法GetDocumentationCommentXml读取XML注释文档</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// C
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name=""Id""&gt;Id&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name=""Name""&gt;Name&lt;/param&gt;
    record C(int Id, string Name);";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver()
    .Compile(sourceCode);
INamedTypeSymbol? classSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("C");
Assert.NotNull(classSymbol);
string? xml = classSymbol.GetDocumentationCommentXml();
Assert.NotNull(xml);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="82-读取xml注释文档的结果">8.2 读取XML注释文档的结果</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>结果是一个完整的XML节点member</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;member name="T:C"&gt;
    &lt;summary&gt;
    C
    &lt;/summary&gt;
    &lt;param name="Id"&gt;Id&lt;/param&gt;
    &lt;param name="Name"&gt;Name&lt;/param&gt;
&lt;/member&gt;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="83-解析xml注释文档">8.3 解析XML注释文档</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>CommentParser.GetSummary解析Summary</li>
<li>CommentParser.Comment解析Summary及参数</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// C
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name=""Id""&gt;Id&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name=""Name""&gt;Name&lt;/param&gt;
    record C(int Id, string Name);";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver()
    .Compile(sourceCode);
INamedTypeSymbol? classSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("C");
Assert.NotNull(classSymbol);
string? xml = classSymbol.GetDocumentationCommentXml();
Assert.NotNull(xml);
string summary = CommentParser.GetSummary(xml);
Assert.Equal("C", summary);
Comment comment = CommentParser.Instance.Get(xml);
Assert.Equal("C", comment.Summary.Trim());
Assert.Equal(2, comment.Params.Count);
Comment comment2 = CommentParser.Comment(classSymbol);
Assert.Equal("C", comment2.Summary.Trim());
Assert.Equal(2, comment2.Params.Count);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="84-解析xml注释文档结果">8.4 解析XML注释文档结果</h3>
<blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/248830/202608/248830-20260815094930661-1800506057.png" alt="Comment" loading="lazy"></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="9-把isymbol的xml注释文档用于生成代码的注释文档">9. 把ISymbol的XML注释文档用于生成代码的注释文档</h2>
<h3 id="91--生成代码的case">9.1  生成代码的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用 SyntaxGenerator.Clone复制类型信息</li>
<li>使用 SymbolReflection.GetPublicPropertiesWithBase遍历属性</li>
<li>CommentParser.GetSummary解析XML注释文档的Summary</li>
<li>WithSummary扩展方法添加XML注释文档的Summary</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sourceCode = @"
    namespace ExampleNamespace;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 用户
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name=""UserName""&gt;用户名&lt;/param&gt;
    public record User(string UserName);
    public partial class UserDTO;
    ";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeDriver.DefaultDriver.Compile(sourceCode);
var syntaxTree = compilation.SyntaxTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(syntaxTree);
var classDeclaration = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().LastOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(classDeclaration);
var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(syntaxTree);
var symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDeclaration);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
var sourceSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("ExampleNamespace.User");
Assert.NotNull(sourceSymbol);
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Clone(classDeclaration);
foreach (var propertySymbol in SymbolReflection.GetPublicPropertiesWithBase(sourceSymbol))
{
    string propertySummary = CommentParser.GetSummary(propertySymbol);
    var propertyType = propertySymbol.Type.ToSyntax();
    var property = propertyType.GetSetProperty(propertySymbol.Name)
        .Public()
        .WithSummary(propertySummary);
    generator.AddProperty(property);
}
string sourceSummary = CommentParser.GetSummary(sourceSymbol);
generator.Apply(type =&gt; type.WithSummary(sourceSummary));
var code = generator.Build().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("&lt;summary&gt;", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="92--生成的代码如下">9.2  生成的代码如下</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace ExampleNamespace;
///&lt;summary&gt;
///用户
///&lt;/summary&gt;
partial class UserDTO
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///用户名
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public string UserName { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="10-示例说明">10. 示例说明</h2>
<h3 id="101-示例执行说明">10.1 示例执行说明</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以上代码执行依赖开源项目EasySyntax、Hand.GenerateCore和Hand.Generators.SyntaxScripting,nuget包如下</li>
<li>Hand.Generators.EasySyntax --version 0.2.1.5</li>
<li>Hand.GenerateCore --version 0.2.1.7</li>
<li>Hand.Generators.SyntaxScripting --version 0.2.1.5-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

</blockquote>
